Review the current implementation.

Read:

- copilot-instructions.md
- user story
- requirements coverage
- modularization plan
- forward-spec.md
- api-contract.yaml
- implementation-scope.md
- tests

Review:

3. Service boundaries
4. API contract
5. Persistence
6. Transactions
7. REST integrations
8. Messaging
9. Resilience
10. Exceptions
11. Logging
12. Security
13. Tests
14. Performance risks

Do not modify production code.

Return findings using:

CRITICAL
HIGH
MEDIUM
LOW
INFO
